content.value: A test on a single cylinder 4-stroke engine with a cylinder diameter of 18 cm and stroke of 28 cm yielded the following:

Speed = 400 rpm, diameter of the brake = 1.52 m, net load on the brake = 1050 N, mep = 7.2 bar, fuel consumption = 3.5 kg/hr, barometer reading = 750 mm Hg, room temperature = 20°C, heating value of fuel = 44 MJ/kg, air-fuel ratio by mass = 25, flow of jacket cooling water = 4.5 kg/min, rise in temperature of cooling water = 38°C, exhaust gas temperature = 210°C.
Determine – (i) indicated and brake thermal efficiency, (ii) volumetric efficiency, and (iii) draw up a heat balance sheet.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2024
